name: codex-vsd-m18-controller
description: Configure and safely control VSDinside and Mirabox M18 Stream Docks on Linux or Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Configure and control an M18 Stream Dock.
interface.longDescription: Inspect Linux or Windows device access, manage 18-key profiles, render LCD artwork, adjust brightness and LEDs, and trigger approved actions through a local MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my M18 and summarize its current setup.
Create a safe M18 profile for media controls.
Update this M18 key and render the profile.
